context.transcript:
Hi, Amal.
This is Jang-Ho Choi.
I'm calling to welcome you to the staff of the Sunrise Times Newspaper.
We're always glad to get skilled writers such as yourself on our team.
Now, I know that sometimes new employees have a lot of questions, because we often hire people fresh out of journalism school.
But you have a lot of experience. you will chat in person next week.
I'm leaving for vacation tomorrow for three days, and I'll see you when I return.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Amal。
我是Jang-Ho Choi。
我打电话来欢迎您加入《Sunrise Times Newspaper》的员工团队。
我们总是很高兴能有像您这样有才华的作家加入我们的团队。
我知道有时新员工会有很多问题，因为我们经常招聘刚从新闻学院毕业的人。
但您有很多经验。我们下周会当面聊聊。
我明天要休假三天，等我回来再见您。
